data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

CANNELL CAPITAL LLC's most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in SJT and GBLI.

On September 18, 2026, SJT filed an earnings release (8-K Item 2.02, Ex. 99.1) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/319655/000119312526395495/sjt-ex99_1.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
